traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Trimeniaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; margins dentate; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in cymes, in racemes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit drupe; stamens 7 to 23; carpels 1 to 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
